full_name: Alyssa A. Goodman | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2016–2017 Physical Sciences Edward, Frances, and Shirley B. Daniels Fellow Harvard University
bio: Alyssa A. Goodman, the Robert Wheeler Willson Professor of Applied Astronomy at Harvard University, wants to learn how the universe works, and she wants others to learn too. Her work spans astronomy, data visualization, science education, and the use of technology in academic research and teaching.
